title: SEG Confirms Edge
description: Schema for a Confirms edge in the Safety Evidence Graph. Direction: TestOutcome → TestSpecification. Created automatically by the CI pipeline when test runner output is processed by the test outcome extractor. Sink edge: no suspicion propagation, no edgeHash, no linkState. Resolution of a suspect confirms edge requires a new test run — human affirmation alone is not sufficient.

seg:from.description: IRI of the TestOutcome node — the one that confirms.

seg:to.description: IRI of the TestSpecification node — the one being confirmed.
